card.name: Sentence openers starting a new point
card.fires_on: Sentence-initial or transition words like "In", "However,", "Additionally," right after a finished sentence, where a new statement begins. Weaker hits appear in "malign|ancy" in contraindication lists.

modes.label: Sentence-start "In"
modes.description: The word "In" opening a sentence right after a full stop, often before a time or setting phrase.

modes.label: Transition word comma
modes.description: The comma after a linking adverb such as Additionally or However that begins a new sentence.

modes.label: End of malignancy
modes.description: The last piece of the word malignancy in lists of breast or uterine conditions.
modes.example: Known or suspected uterine or cervical malign<<ancy>> Uterine bleeding of unknown etiology
